install_ios: Tap the Share button (□↑) at the bottom of Safari.
Tap 'Add' — the church icon appears on your home screen.
install_android: Tap the menu (⋮) at the top right of Chrome.
Choose 'Add to Home screen' or 'Install app'.
Tap 'Install' — the church icon appears on your home screen.
install_inapp: This can't be done inside apps like KakaoTalk or Naver.
Use the menu to 'Open in another browser'.
Then tap this button again in Chrome (Android) or Safari (iPhone).
install_pc: Click the install icon (⊕ or 🖥) at the right end of the Chrome or Edge address bar.
Click 'Install' — the church app is added to your desktop/Start menu and opens in its own window.
No icon? Open the browser menu (⋮) → 'Apps' or 'Cast, save and share' → 'Install'.
